name: @codemao/browser-game-sandbox
description: Bare browser sandbox host bridge for untrusted web games

scripts.test:vue: npm run build && npm --prefix test/vue-compat install --no-package-lock --ignore-scripts && npm --prefix test/vue-compat run build
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.config.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run check:types && npm run test:vue && npm run test:browser
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run check:types && npm test
